description: Pre-match head-to-head odds for one sport from The Odds API (v4): each event with start time, teams and each bookmaker's decimal prices, plus the best price per outcome and which bookmaker offers it. Needs the owner's free The Odds API key; uses quota on that key. Related tools on this server, for a different need: dev_academy_sports_outdoors when you need Academy Sports + Outdoors products on one category page; dev_espn_sports when you need ESPN latest news headlines for one league from ESPN's. Price: $0.002 in USDC per successful call, paid with x402 (Base, Solana or Arc); failed calls are not charged.

regions.description: Bookmaker region: us, uk, eu or au (default uk)

sport.description: The Odds API sport key, e.g. soccer_epl, basketball_nba, americanfootball_nfl

name: dev_the_odds_api_sports
title: Pre-match head-to-head odds for one sport from The Odds
